fusions.name: Plummeting Cleave
fusions.desc: Drops onto an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 30 damage, rising to 1.6 times that from full range. The blow ignores armour.

fusions.name: Felling Arc
fusions.desc: Cleaves a claw through a cone 2 tiles long, dealing 11 damage to everything in it and knocking them back 2.5 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Claw Whetting
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Split Hairs
fusions.desc: Your slashing damage cannot be resisted.
